svg.text: Emilia | SEPARATE BODY HYPOTHESIS + compatibility review
SYNTHETIC CONSTRUCTION. Not anime evidence. No garment or anatomy is observed in these drawings.
Body contours and five section shapes are UNCHANGED. Old photo hypothesis overlays are withdrawn as evidence.
Dashed interior strokes show synthetic construction flow only. No drawn shading is used as evidence.
A-E | same complete torso sections; ALL INTERPOLATED
No section coordinate is an official measurement. Front below / back above. No cloth outline is a body target.
Actual S4 cloth over this body: qualitative compatibility, not a calibrated fit
Evidence remains on sheets 1-2. No new white-cloth drawing is invented to rescue this hypothesis.
S4 OBSERVED: All primary frames reveal purple in the opening and/or below the hems.
HYPOTHESIS TEST: One continuous torso supplies this surface. No seam, attached pad or medial groove is required.
Changing scalloped overlap and outer flare
S4 OBSERVED: Front and running frames show unequal cloth edges crossing purple; side frames retain partial overlaps.
HYPOTHESIS TEST: The same smooth body permits independent cloth overlap. Hem height never fixes a body shelf or pocket.
COMPATIBLE IF CLOTH IS FREE TO OVERLAP
S4 OBSERVED: The opening appears near symmetric in front, partial/asymmetric in oblique views, and hidden behind arms.
HYPOTHESIS TEST: A continuous surface works behind these apertures. The white borders cannot set anterior depth or far-side width.
S4 OBSERVED: Seated/running upper limits are cloth- and pose-dependent; standing oblique arms conceal the fullest region.
HYPOTHESIS TEST: No repeated original S4 observation proves or refutes the present section depths. S1 costume edges do not resolve them.
Revision decision: no contour/section change justified by garment evidence alone.
The fitted-cloth assumption is rejected. Hidden body depth remains unapproved, rather than being re-inferred from white edges.
S1 stays secondary structural support only. A future body hypothesis must yield if stronger original S4 body evidence contradicts it.
NO MESH EDITS. NO GARMENT MESH EDITS. NO GLB BUILD. STOP FOR REVIEW.
